package teacherdialog_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
)

type provisionTeacherStub struct{ teacher domain.PersonalTeacher }

func (stub provisionTeacherStub) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return stub.teacher, nil
}

type dialogProvisionerStub struct {
	binding           domain.TeacherDialogBinding
	studentID         string
	personalTeacherID string
	contextType       domain.LearningContextType
	contextID         string
}

func (stub *dialogProvisionerStub) EnsureTeacherDialog(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	personalTeacherID string,
	contextType domain.LearningContextType,
	contextID string,
) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	stub.studentID = studentID
	stub.personalTeacherID = personalTeacherID
	stub.contextType = contextType
	stub.contextID = contextID
	return stub.binding, nil
}

func TestProvisionUsesCanonicalTeacherIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	teacher, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher(
		"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", studentID,
		domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: studentID,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson,
		ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", Created: true,
	}
	dialogs := &dialogProvisionerStub{binding: binding}
	useCase := teacherdialog.Provision{Teachers: provisionTeacherStub{teacher: teacher}, Dialogs: dialogs}

	got, err := useCase.Execute(context.Background(), teacherdialog.ProvisionInput{
		StudentID: studentID, ContextType: binding.ContextType, ContextID: binding.ContextID,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, binding, got)
	require.Equal(t, teacher.ID, dialogs.personalTeacherID)
}

func TestProvisionFailsClosedOnDialogIdentityDrift(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	teacher, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher(
		"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", studentID,
		domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), time.Now(),
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	dialogs := &dialogProvisionerStub{binding: domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	}}
	useCase := teacherdialog.Provision{Teachers: provisionTeacherStub{teacher: teacher}, Dialogs: dialogs}

	_, err = useCase.Execute(context.Background(), teacherdialog.ProvisionInput{
		StudentID: studentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable)
}
